title: Mitchell TTX · CCA sustainment
subtitle: Forward dispersion and constrained logistics · Figures 11–12
description: Study of Mitchell's 2024 TTX logistics findings: forward CCA posture, prepositioning and sustainment risks; constrained munitions inventories shift sortie allocations toward electronic attack and decoys.
assumptions: Published mission concepts and qualitative force-mix findings are taken from Mitchell Institute 2025 report (2024 TTX); these are hypothetical tabletop exercise plans, not observed combat operations.
Actor trajectories, coordinates, formation separations, icons, scene timing and visual counts are editorial illustrations. The report does not publish precise flight tracks or combat outcomes.
Scenario timeline is presentation seconds, not the exercise's operational day or campaign duration.
Notional CCA-1 through CCA-12 are study constructs; do not equate them with actual YFQ-designated prototypes.

phases.title: Preposition resources
phases.narrative: The HVAA team prepositioned CCA and munitions in the Ryukyus; subsequent crewed resupply near Taiwan was judged high-risk.

phases.title: Disperse forward CCA
phases.narrative: TTX teams favored dispersed launch/recovery options in southern Japan and the northern Philippines, with reduced runway and ground-footprint requirements.

phases.title: Generate CCA sorties
phases.narrative: Fuel, munitions, personnel and equipment determine the ability to generate the proposed sorties; the map shows no simulated sortie rate.

phases.title: Examine resupply exposure
phases.narrative: The report identifies theater airlift and munition replenishment risks and considers alternative uncrewed logistics support.

phases.title: Adapt posture and force mix
phases.narrative: Under constraints the teams considered greater reliance on air-launched expendable CCA and nonkinetic mission systems.

phases.title: Constrained logistics finding
phases.narrative: Figure 12: sweep team's weapon-launch share declined from 96% to 68%; SEAD team's from 76% to 33%, with a corresponding increase in EW/decoy sorties.
